bull.b: BRUKINSA's leading position, broad indication coverage, and presence across 80+ markets create a scalable commercial base. Treatment of more than 300,000 patients supports recurring demand and provides infrastructure for further geographic and label expansion.

The recent profitability inflection and substantial free cash flow improve BeOne's ability to fund clinical development, manufacturing expansion, and commercialization internally. High gross margins and improving cash conversion also strengthen resilience as the portfolio expands.

Regulatory progress and several late-stage programs broaden BeOne beyond its current lead product. A deeper pipeline can support additional indications, reduce reliance on one franchise over time, and create new commercial opportunities in hematology and solid tumors.

bear.b: Competition in BTK and combination therapies could raise promotional requirements, constrain pricing, or slow BRUKINSA share gains. Even without meaningful current U.S. impact, rival launches may pressure adoption and economics as treatment options broaden.

bear.t: Historical Cash Flow Volatility and Higher Leverage
bear.b: Current liquidity and cash generation are strong, but the recent turnaround follows multiple years of losses and negative cash flow. Higher leverage than earlier periods increases the importance of sustained earnings and disciplined investment if operating conditions weaken.

The mixed CELESTIAL-301 result creates uncertainty around one combination program's differentiation and regulatory reception. At the same time, higher spending on commercial and pipeline activities may delay margin expansion if trials or launches fail to generate expected returns.
